settings-value-reverted-invalid: That value isn’t valid, so it wasn’t saved.
setup-wizard-abandon-confirm-message: Are you sure you want to leave? This congregation's setup isn't finished yet, and navigating away now will cancel it.
setup-wizard-obs-replaces-zoom-sharing: Zoom is set to share the media window. If you choose a media scene for @:{'obsStudio'}, @:obsStudio will show the media in Zoom instead, and Zoom's media sharing will be turned off.
setup-wizard-zoom-manager-explain: M³ can take care of Zoom around each meeting: open your congregation's meeting, join computer audio and unmute your microphone, turn your camera on or off, mute everyone when the meeting starts and let them unmute afterwards, and share the media window while media is shown.
setup-wizard-zoom-manager-ready: The Zoom Meeting Manager is set up.
setup-wizard-zoom-manager-setup-explain: The Zoom setup assistant checks your Zoom, learns the names of its buttons in your language, and tries everything with you. Open your congregation's Zoom meeting first. If now isn't a good time, you can set it up later from Settings or from the Zoom button.
setupWizard.chooseSharedFolder: Choose the folder where files for meetings will be kept. It should be inside your Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive or Google Drive folder, so that it stays in sync.
setupWizard.chooseSharedFolderTip: Tip: Create a new, empty folder just for this, such as "Meeting media", since M³ adds folders to it and can delete old ones.
setupWizard.completeRequiredFields: Please complete the field(s) above to continue.
setupWizard.intro: O M³ torna a reprodução de conteúdo multimédia nas reuniões de congregação fácil e sem stress. Vamos configurar algumas coisas e estará pronto a começar.
setupWizard.sharedFolderAddFiles: Whenever you need to, put photos, videos, audio files or JW Library playlists in a meeting's folder. They're added to that meeting's media list automatically.
setupWizard.sharedFolderHowItWorks: M³ creates a folder inside it for each upcoming meeting, named with the meeting's date written as year-month-day, like this:
setupWizard.sharedFolderIntro: If so, M³ can add the photos, videos and other files put in a folder there to the right meeting automatically. This is handy when others prepare media for their parts and share it with you, or when M³ is used on more than one computer.
setupWizard.sharedFolderOfflineTip: Tip: In your cloud storage app, set this folder to always stay on this computer (often called "available offline"), so its files are ready before the meeting starts.
setupWizard.sharedFolderOtherDays: To add files for another day, create a folder for it, named the same way.
setupWizard.sharedFolderQuestion: Do you keep files for meetings in an app like Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive or Google Drive?
shortcut-already-assigned: That key combination is already assigned to “{action}”
shortcutMediaNext: Ir para o próximo item de multimédia
shortcutMediaNext-explain: Atalho para selecionar o próximo vídeo ou imagem na lista.
shortcutMediaPauseResume-explain: Atalho para reproduzir ou pausar o multimédia atualmente selecionado. Se o multimédia for uma imagem, pausar terá o mesmo efeito que parar.
shortcutMediaPrevious: Ir para o item de multimédia anterior
shortcutMediaPrevious-explain: Atalho para selecionar o vídeo ou imagem anterior na lista.
shortcutMediaStop-explain: Atalho para parar a reprodução do multimédia atualmente selecionado.
shortcutMediaWindow-explain: Atalho para esconder ou mostrar rapidamente a janela de multimédia.
shortcutMusic-explain: Atalho para iniciar ou parar a música de fundo.
show-hidden-media-explain: Isto irá mostrar toda a multimédia que foi previamente ocultada para o dia atualmente selecionado.
show-image-for-zoom-participants: Exibir imagem para os participantes do Zoom
showMediaDragHandle: Show drag handle on media items
showMediaDragHandle-explain: Show a small handle on each media item for dragging it to reorder. Media items can always be reordered by dragging anywhere on them; this only affects the handle icon itself.
sign-language-bible-media: Adicionar multimédia da Bíblia em língua gestual
slideshow-audio-loop: The currently playing video and audio will loop until playback is manually stopped
snap-connect-both: M³ needs your permission to use folders on USB drives and other disks, and to keep the OBS Studio password encrypted.
snap-connect-command: Run this command in a terminal:
snap-connect-command-copied: Command copied. Paste it in a terminal and press Enter.
snap-connect-command-restart: Run this command in a terminal, then restart M³:
snap-connect-password-manager-service: M³ needs your permission to keep the OBS Studio password encrypted.
snap-connect-removable-media: M³ needs your permission to use folders on USB drives and other disks.
some-media-items-are-hidden: Alguns itens de multimédia foram ocultados.
some-media-items-are-missing: Alguns ficheiros multimédia estão em falta
some-media-items-are-missing-explain: Alguns itens multimédia não puderam ser transferidos automaticamente. Pode adicioná-los manualmente, se necessário, utilizando o menu @:extra-media ou arrastando-os do seu computador para a lista de multimédia.
some-songs-are-duplicated: Algum cântico aparece mais de uma vez na lista de multimédia. Por favor, verifique se isso é intencional.
song-already-in-meeting-message: Song {number} is already in this meeting. Add it a second time?
song-already-in-meeting-title: This song is already in the meeting
song-media-item-explain: This media item is a meeting song
special-week-co-midweek: This week, the midweek meeting is on Tuesday. M³ hides the Congregation Bible Study's media and the closing song.
special-week-co-moved-explain: The circuit overseer is visiting this week, so the midweek meeting is on {date}.
special-week-co-other: This week, the midweek meeting is on {date}.
special-week-co-weekend: The circuit overseer's talk follows the Watchtower Study. M³ hides the closing song.
special-week-memorial-day: M³ adds the Memorial's welcome video and songs, and shows its image instead of the yeartext.
special-week-memorial-replaced-explain: The Memorial on {date} takes its place.
special-week-mw-as-usual: The midweek meeting is as usual.
special-week-we-as-usual: The weekend meeting is as usual.
stop-playing-media-first: Por favor, pare a reprodução de conteúdo multimédia antes de navegar para uma página diferente.
stop-playing-media-first-explain: Não pode mudar de página enquanto o conteúdo multimédia está a ser reproduzido.
stop-repeat-media-item-explain: Escolha esta opção se o item multimédia selecionado deve ser reproduzido até ao fim e depois parar.
study-bible-media: Images, videos, charts and maps from the @:study-bible
suppressHardwareAccelerationReminder: Ocultar lembrete de aceleração de hardware
suppressHardwareAccelerationReminder-exp: Desativa o lembrete para reativar a aceleração de hardware caso esta tenha sido desativada manualmente.
sureStopVideo: Tem a certeza de que deseja parar o vídeo?
the-name-of-your-congregation-or-group-w: O nome do perfil irá ajudá-lo a alternar rapidamente entre perfis, caso decida criar mais do que um no futuro.
there-are-no-media-items-for-the-selecte: Não há itens de multimédia para a data selecionada.
this-is-a-test-version: Esta é uma versão de teste! Use-a apenas para fins de teste e não a mantenha instalada.
this-song-is-duplicated: Este cântico aparece mais do que uma vez na lista de multimédia.
this-will-only-delete-media-for-this-day: Esta ação irá apenas remover os itens que foram adicionados manualmente para o dia selecionado
this-will-speed-up-media-retrieval-for-m: Isto irá acelerar a recuperação de multimédia para as reuniões, mas não é obrigatório.
thisShouldBeInvestigatedToEnsureThatAllR: This should be investigated to ensure that all required meeting media is present
timer-part-counts-message: Choose the number of parts in this meeting, so that each part gets the right amount of time. M³ asks once for each meeting. You can change it later under Advanced in the timer popup.
timer-part-counts-title: How many parts does this meeting have?
timer-remote-firewall-allowed: Windows Firewall now lets other devices open the timer page.
timer-remote-firewall-blocks-all: Windows Firewall blocks all incoming connections on the network this computer is on, so other devices can't open this page. That can be changed in Windows Security, under Firewall & network protection.
timer-remote-firewall-failed: M³ couldn't change Windows Firewall's settings.
timer-remote-firewall-not-allowed: Windows Firewall may keep other devices from opening this page on the network this computer is on. Allowing it needs an administrator's permission.
timer-remote-firewall-still-blocked: Windows Firewall still blocks the timer page for other devices. A rule M³ can't change, such as one set by an organization, may be blocking it.
timer-remote-no-network: No network connection was found. Connect this computer to the same network as the tablet.
timer-remote-open-on-device: Open one of these addresses in the browser of a tablet or phone on the same network:
timer-remote-port-in-use: The timer remote couldn't start: another program already uses its port. Choose another port in the settings.
timer-report-file-not-writable: The meeting timing report could not be saved. If a file with the same name is open in another program, close it and try again, or save the report in another folder.
timer-report-not-saved: The meeting timing report could not be saved.
timer-report-saved: The meeting timing report was saved.
timerAutoOpen-explain: Automatically open the timer window on application launch or when changing congregations.
timerBackgroundColor-explain: The background color of the timer window.
timerCountdownDisplay-explain: Choose how countdown timers are shown in the timer window.
timerCountdownWarningIndicator-explain: When enabled, the analog countdown ring gradually shifts from green toward a warning color during the final 60 seconds.
timerDockedPanel: Show a timer panel in the main window
timerDockedPanel-explain: Keep the meeting parts and timer controls in a panel on the right side of the main window, always in view, instead of only in the action island popup.
timerEnableMeetingAheadBehind-explain: When enabled, the timer will display whether the meeting is ahead or behind schedule.
timerEnableMeetingCountdown-explain: Show a countdown timer until the start of scheduled meetings.
timerHourFormat-explain: Choose whether the timer window clock uses 12-hour or 24-hour time.
timerIslandHoverControls: Quick controls when hovering the timer button
timerIslandHoverControls-explain: Hovering the timer button on the action island shows the part being timed, with buttons to start, pause, stop and move on to the next part, without opening the timer popup.
timerMeetingCountdownMinutes-explain: Configure the number of minutes for which the countdown timer should be shown on the timer display before the start of scheduled meetings. Note that the countdown is never displayed on the main media display.
timerMode-explain: Choose whether the timer should count up or count down by default.
timerOvertimeAnimation-explain: Make the timer gently blink when the participant is overtime.
timerOvertimeBackgroundColor-explain: The background color of the timer window when the participant is overtime.
timerOvertimeIndicator-explain: When enabled, the timer will visually indicate if the participant has gone overtime.
timerOvertimeShowAmountOnly: Show only elapsed overtime amount in count-up mode
timerOvertimeShowAmountOnly-explain: If using count-up mode, and if the planned duration is exceeded, the timer will display the amount of time by which the participant is over (e.g. -00:30) instead of the total elapsed part time.
timerOvertimeTextColor-explain: The text color of the timer when the participant is overtime.
timerRemoteEnable: Timer remote (page for a tablet or phone)
timerRemoteEnable-explain: Serve a read-only copy of the timer display as a web page on your local network, for example for a tablet at the lectern, so the speaker sees the remaining time without it being on the congregation's screen or in a Zoom share. All the controls stay in M³. Anyone on the same network can open the page while this is on.
timerRemoteFocusLayout: Focus layout for the timer remote
timerRemoteFocusLayout-explain: Use a large progress ring instead of the plain time, and list the Zoom participants whose hand is raised beside it, in the order they raised them. The ring turns yellow in the last minute, then red with the overtime amount. The names appear while the raised-hand alert is on. Off keeps the current display.
timerRemotePort-explain: The network port the timer page is served on. Change it only if another program already uses it.
timerSeparateCounsel-explain: After the Bible reading and each @:ayfm part, time the minute of counsel as a part of its own, so the chairman can see how much of it is left. The timing report lists it on its own line. The meeting's schedule stays the same.
timerShowOnActionIsland: Show timer value on action island
timerShowOnActionIsland-explain: Show the current timer value on the action island timer button.
timerShowPlannedStartTimes-explain: Show when each part should start in the timer's list of parts. This only changes what's displayed, not how the meeting is timed.
timerTextColor-explain: The color of the timer text.
timerTextSize-explain: The size of the timer text.
timerTimeOfDayDisplay-explain: Choose how the current time is shown when no participant timer is running.
to-quickly-show-and-hide-zoom-participan: Dica: Para garantir que pode mostrar e esconder rapidamente os participantes do Zoom nos ecrãs da TV quando necessário, certifique-se de que a configuração para "usar monitores duplos" no Zoom está ativada.
unable-to-load-media-for-the-selected-da: Unable to load media for the selected date
update-available-please-update: Está disponível uma nova versão do M³! Recomendamos a atualização para receber as funcionalidades, correções de bugs e atualizações de segurança mais recentes.
update-downloaded-downgrade: Version {version} of M³ has been downloaded and is ready to be installed. This will downgrade your app to an earlier version.
update-downloading: Uma nova versão do M³ está disponível e a ser transferida em segundo plano.
update-error-disk-full: M³ couldn’t install its update because there’s no space left on this computer’s disk. Free up some disk space, then restart M³ to try again.
update-error-read-only-volume: O M³ não pôde ser atualizado porque está guardado num diretório de leitura apenas. Por favor, mova o M³ para um local diferente, como a pasta Aplicações.
update-install-asks-permission: Windows will ask for permission to install it
update-install-countdown: M³ will restart to install it in {seconds} s
updates-disabled-warning: Ative as atualizações para receber novas funcionalidades, correções de erros e atualizações de segurança importantes.
use-the-import-button-to-add-media-for-t: Utilize o botão @:extra-media para adicionar multimédia para esta data, ou selecione uma data diferente para ver a multimédia correspondente a esse dia.
use-the-slider-below-to-adjust-the-start: Use o controlo deslizante abaixo para ajustar o tempo de início e de fim desta multimédia. Isto é útil para reproduzir apenas certas partes de um vídeo.
watch-folder-error-caption: Make sure the app that keeps it in sync, such as Dropbox or OneDrive, is running, and that the folder still exists and M³ is allowed to save files in it.
watch-folder-error-message: M³ can't read the shared folder.
watched-media-item-explain: This media item was added from the shared folder
website-unreachable: The website couldn’t be loaded because this computer couldn’t reach it. Check the internet connection, then refresh the page.
weDay: Dia da reunião de fim de semana
weDay-explain: Escolha o dia em que ocorre a reunião de fim de semana.
weeks-ago: This week | Last week | {count} weeks ago
weeks-from-now: This week | Next week | In {count} weeks
well-start-fetching-media-while-we-wrap-: Vamos começar a procurar a multimédia enquanto terminamos a nossa configuração inicial.
weStartTime: Hora da reunião de fim de semana
weStartTime-explain: Escolha a hora em que a reunião de fim de semana começa.
what-are-your-meeting-days-and-times-wel: Quais são os dias e horários das suas reuniões? Usaremos esta informação para exibir o calendário de multimédia.
what-kind-of-profile-is-this: Escolha o tipo de perfil que deseja criar.
what-language-would-you-like-m-to-be-dis: Em que idioma gostaria que o M³ fosse exibido?
when-you-are-done-presenting-the-website: Quando já não precisar de apresentar o site, feche a janela do site ou clique no botão “Parar Espelhamento” no canto superior direito desta janela.
when-you-click-the-button-on-the-top-rig: When you click the "Open Website" button on the top right corner of this window, a new window will open to the @:{'official-website-of-jw'}.
while-the-website-window-is-open-zoom-an: While the website window is open, zoom and navigation buttons are available in the top right corner of this window.
willProbablyBeAvailableLater: However, the missing media is likely to become available closer to the meeting date
would-you-like-to-enable-songbook-video-: Gostaria de armazenar em cache todos os cânticos?
would-you-like-to-integrate-m-with-obs-s: Would you like to integrate M³ with @:{'obsStudio'}?
would-you-like-to-integrate-zoom: Gostaria de integrar o M³ com o Zoom?
yeartext-cleared: O texto do ano para {currentYear} foi agora restaurado.
yeartext-preview-failed: Falha ao obter o texto do ano para {year}. Por favor, tente novamente mais tarde.
yeartext-preview-next-year: Gostaria de pré-visualizar o texto do ano para {year}?
yeartext-preview-success: O texto do ano para {year} será agora exibido durante 10 segundos.
you-can-navigate-the-website-before-pres: Se necessário, pode navegar para uma página específica antes de apresentá-la ao público. Quando estiver pronto, pressione o botão “Iniciar Espelhamento” no canto superior direito desta janela. O que vê na janela do site será exibido na janela de multimédia para o público.
zoom-audio-already-joined: Already joined computer audio in Zoom
zoom-automation-failed: Some Zoom settings couldn't be applied automatically. Please check Zoom.
zoom-automations-off-for-meeting: Zoom automations are off for this meeting
zoom-automations-paused-declined: You skipped the Zoom check before this meeting, so M³ won't operate Zoom for it. Choose Test again to turn its automations back on.
zoom-automations-paused-failed: What failed at the last check: {problems}. M³ won't run its Zoom automations until a check passes.
zoom-check-ask-explain: M³ needs to test that everything is in place for Zoom to be automated. The check takes less than 15 seconds: Zoom's window comes forward and M³ presses a few of its buttons.
zoom-check-declined-caption: M³ won't operate Zoom for this meeting. Choose Test again in the Zoom popup to turn its automations back on.
zoom-check-failed-caption: M³ checked Zoom and this didn't work: {problems}. To avoid a mistake during the meeting, M³ won't operate Zoom until it's restarted or a new check passes.
zoom-check-names-changed: Zoom's buttons no longer read the way M³ learned them, usually because Zoom's language was changed or Zoom was updated. M³ won't run its Zoom automations until the setup assistant has learned their new names.
zoom-check-passed: M³ checked Zoom: everything it automates works.
zoom-check-result-by-hand: Don't automate Zoom for this meeting
zoom-check-result-later: You can test again later from the Zoom Meeting Manager button at the bottom of the window.
zoom-check-skip-confirm-message: M³ won't operate Zoom for this meeting, so you'll do in Zoom what M³ would have done. Its automations stay off until a check passes.
zoom-check-skip-confirm-title: Turn off Zoom automations for this meeting?
zoom-check-while-sharing: M³ can't check Zoom while it's sharing. Stop sharing in Zoom, then test again.
zoom-dialog-in-the-way: A Zoom window is open (a dialog or a popup) and may be in M³'s way. Close it in Zoom.
zoom-display-setup-ask-explain: If so, we'll make sure everyone in the hall can see them on the TV when it's their turn. It only takes a minute.
zoom-display-setup-ask-mw: Will any of today's parts be presented by someone on Zoom?
zoom-display-setup-ask-we: Will the speaker be on Zoom today?
zoom-display-setup-check-explain: Have a look at the TV: the media display is hidden for now.
zoom-display-setup-check-title: Is Zoom's window full screen on the TV?
zoom-display-setup-done-explain: The media display is showing again, over Zoom's window. Next, a quick reminder of how to show Zoom on the TV when it's time for someone to present a part from Zoom.
zoom-display-setup-dual-window-tip: Tip: with Zoom's "Meeting window view" set to "Dual window", Zoom shows the participants in a second window, which can stay full screen on the TV, behind the media display.
zoom-display-setup-explain: M³ will hide the media display for now. Once it's hidden, make sure Zoom's window with the participants is on the TV and fills the whole screen.
zoom-display-setup-explain-auto: M³ will hide the media display for now, then put Zoom's second window full screen on the TV, behind it.
zoom-display-setup-fix-explain: Double-click the middle of Zoom's window on the TV: it should then fill the whole screen. If Zoom's window isn't on the TV yet, drag it there first.
zoom-display-setup-later-explain: Remember to make the Zoom window full screen on the TV before it's time to show it. Enjoy the meeting!
zoom-display-setup-placement-failed: M³ couldn't move Zoom's window. Please check the Zoom window on the TV yourself.
zoom-display-setup-placement-full-screen: M³ made sure Zoom's second window is full screen on the TV. Have a look to confirm.
zoom-display-setup-placement-no-meeting: M³ couldn't find a Zoom meeting. Join the meeting in Zoom, then try again.
zoom-display-setup-placement-no-second-w: Zoom shows the meeting in a single window. Set Zoom's "Meeting window view" to "Dual window", then try again.
zoom-display-setup-placement-not-full-sc: M³ moved Zoom's second window to the TV, but couldn't make it full screen.
zoom-display-setup-placing: Putting Zoom's window full screen on the TV…
zoom-display-setup-turn-off-message: M³ won't ask about the Zoom window placement before meetings anymore. You can turn this feature back on in Settings, under Congregation Meetings.
zoom-display-tour-button-body: Click the media display button to open its menu.
zoom-display-tour-button-title: Showing Zoom participants on the TV
zoom-display-tour-hide-body: Then click Hide media display: this will show the Zoom window, which is normally hidden behind the media display.
zoom-display-tour-show-body: Once the Zoom part is done, use the same menu and button to show the media display on top of the Zoom window again.
zoom-hand-setup-needed: M³ first needs to learn how Zoom marks raised hands. The setup assistant does this with you in a moment.
zoom-hand-mic-ambiguous: M³ couldn't tell this row's buttons apart in Zoom's participants list, so it pressed nothing. If this keeps happening after a Zoom update, please report it.
zoom-hand-mic-not-learned: M³ first needs to learn your Zoom microphone button, in the setup assistant.
zoom-hand-muted-and-lowered: {name} is muted and their hand is lowered
zoom-hand-name-ambiguous: Two participants have this name, so M³ didn't touch either, to be safe. Ask one of them to rename themselves.
zoom-hand-participant-gone: That participant is no longer in the meeting's list.
zoom-hand-unmute-requested: Asked {name} to unmute (or unmuted them) in Zoom
zoom-hand-unmuted: {name} was asked to unmute. When they're done:
zoom-helper-error-generic: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart M³.
zoom-helper-error-helper-blocked: Windows blocks a file M³ needs to control Zoom: Smart App Control, or an organization's security policy, doesn't let it run on this computer. M³ can't control Zoom while Windows blocks it.
zoom-helper-error-helper-missing: Some of M³'s files for controlling Zoom are missing, perhaps removed by an antivirus. Reinstalling M³ should restore them.
zoom-helper-error-powershell-broken: Windows PowerShell, which M³ needs to control Zoom, doesn't start on this computer: it stops with an error as soon as it opens. M³ can't control Zoom until Windows PowerShell is repaired.
zoom-helper-error-powershell-not-found: Windows PowerShell, which M³ needs to control Zoom, wasn't found on this computer.
zoom-helper-error-powershell-restricted: Windows PowerShell is restricted on this computer (for example by an organization's security policy), so M³ can't control Zoom.
zoom-helper-error-windows-only: The Zoom Meeting Manager is only available on Windows.
zoom-helper-start-failed: The Zoom Meeting Manager couldn't start.
zoom-host-mic-mute-failed: M³ couldn’t mute the host microphone in Zoom for the media, so Zoom participants may hear its sound twice.
zoom-host-mic-off-for-media: Host microphone muted while the media plays
zoom-host-mic-unmute-failed: M³ couldn’t unmute the host microphone in Zoom after the media. Unmute it in Zoom so Zoom participants can hear the hall again.
zoom-integration-explain: Ative isto para permitir que o M³ inicie e pare automaticamente a partilha de ecrã do Zoom quando a reprodução de conteúdo multimédia começar e terminar.
zoom-layout-arrange-explain: Puts M³ and Zoom where the window layout from the setup assistant says.
zoom-layout-arrange-failed: M³ couldn't arrange the windows: no Zoom meeting window was found.
zoom-layout-list-moved: Zoom is sharing, so M³ put its participants list where Zoom's window goes.
zoom-layout-moved: M³ put Zoom's meeting window where you chose.
zoom-layout-moved-caption: "Leave Zoom alone" lasts until M³ restarts. "Turn off" lasts until you turn the window layout back on in Settings.
zoom-layout-screen-missing: The screen chosen for Zoom isn't available, so Zoom shares M³'s screen for now.
zoom-layout-turned-off: Window layout turned off. You can turn it back on in Settings, under Zoom Meeting Manager.
zoom-meeting-manager-meeting-id-missing: Set a Zoom meeting ID in the settings to launch the meeting from here.
zoom-meeting-window-searching: Looking for a Zoom meeting window…
zoom-meeting-window-time-not-found: It's meeting time, but no Zoom meeting window is detected
zoom-outdated-version: Zoom {version} is older than Zoom {tested}, the version M³ is tested with
zoom-outdated-version-caption: Some features may be less reliable with it. Update Zoom at your earliest convenience.
zoom-run-arrange-windows: Arranging M³ and Zoom on your screens
zoom-run-cancel-hint: To stop it from anywhere, even while Zoom has the focus, press {shortcut}.
zoom-run-cancelled: The Zoom automation was cancelled. Zoom may have been left part-way; please check it.
zoom-run-explain: M³ is working in the Zoom app. Your mouse and the focused window may move on their own for a moment. Please wait and don't touch them.
zoom-run-learn-hand: Learning how Zoom marks raised hands
zoom-run-media-sharing-start: Sharing the media window in Zoom
zoom-run-media-sharing-stop: Stopping the media share in Zoom
zoom-run-second-window-full-screen: Putting Zoom's second window full screen on the TV
zoom-self-test-explain: Runs every Zoom Meeting Manager action against the open Zoom meeting and checks the result, from the host's side and the test participants' side. Only use a test meeting: it mutes everyone.
zoom-self-test-step-mute-all-locked: Mute everyone, without letting them unmute
zoom-self-test-step-restore: Restore the host audio and video
zoom-setup-automations-intro: Choose what M³ does for you. You can change this later in Settings.
zoom-setup-banner: Finish setting up the Zoom Meeting Manager.
zoom-setup-checks-intro: M³ is making sure it can find everything it needs in Zoom.
zoom-setup-done-intro: The Zoom Meeting Manager is ready. You can come back to this assistant anytime from the Zoom button or from Settings.
zoom-setup-feature-audio: Joins or leaves computer audio, unmutes your microphone, and turns your camera on or off at the right moments
zoom-setup-feature-hand: Tells you when someone raises their hand, to unmute them with one click
zoom-setup-feature-launch: Opens your congregation's Zoom meeting before it starts
zoom-setup-feature-mute: Mutes everyone when the meeting starts, and lets them unmute afterwards
zoom-setup-feature-share: Shares the media window in Zoom while media is shown
zoom-setup-fix-buttons: Make sure Zoom's meeting controls show the microphone and camera buttons, then check again.
zoom-setup-fix-host: Only the meeting's host or a co-host can mute everyone. Sign in to Zoom as the host of this meeting.
zoom-setup-fix-meeting: Open your meeting in the Zoom app.
zoom-setup-fix-participants: Open the Participants panel in Zoom, then check again.
zoom-setup-fix-toolbar: Make sure the Zoom meeting window isn't hidden behind other windows, then check again.
zoom-setup-hand-failed: M³ couldn't raise your hand in Zoom, or didn't see it in the participants list. Make sure your meeting is open in Zoom. If your hand is still raised in Zoom, lower it, then try again.
zoom-setup-hand-intro: M³ can tell you when someone raises their hand in Zoom, so you can unmute them with one click, then mute them again and lower their hand when they're done. Zoom marks raised hands in your language, so M³ needs to see one: it raises your own hand for a moment, reads how Zoom marks it, then lowers it again.
zoom-setup-hand-timer-off: The notifications and buttons work on their own. If you enable the meeting timer, a large hand with the participant's name will also appear on the timer display for the chairman.
zoom-setup-hand-timer-on: Since the meeting timer is enabled, a large hand with the participant's name will also appear on the timer display for the chairman.
zoom-setup-layout-alone-explain: Zoom fills this screen. M³ stays on {display}.
zoom-setup-layout-alone-intro: Zoom's meeting will fill its screen.
zoom-setup-layout-arrange-failed: M³ couldn't arrange the windows. Is the Zoom meeting open?
zoom-setup-layout-dual-monitors: With Zoom's "Meeting window view" set to "Dual window" ("Use dual monitors" in older versions of Zoom), M³ puts Zoom's second window full screen on {display}, behind the media window: hide the media window to see it.
zoom-setup-layout-intro: M³ can put Zoom's meeting window, and its own window, in place when the meeting starts, then keep Zoom there.
zoom-setup-layout-keep: Put Zoom back if it moves
zoom-setup-layout-keep-explain: After screen sharing, when its participants list opens or closes, or when a screen is connected. If you move Zoom yourself, M³ leaves it there until the next meeting.
zoom-setup-layout-left-alone: M³ won't move any window. You can come back to this step at any time.
zoom-setup-layout-media-screen: The media window fills this screen
zoom-setup-layout-media-takes-other: {media} shows the media window, so Zoom shares {display} with M³.
zoom-setup-layout-next-to-m3-explain: M³ moves to this screen too, and they share it.
zoom-setup-layout-one-screen: Only one screen is connected, so Zoom and M³ share it.
zoom-setup-layout-participants-explain: M³ opens it when the meeting starts, then arranges the windows, so the list opening doesn't push Zoom out of place.
zoom-setup-layout-pick-screen: Pick the screen for Zoom's meeting.
zoom-setup-layout-pick-screen-media: Pick the screen for Zoom's meeting. {media} isn't offered: the media window fills it.
zoom-setup-layout-share-participants: Show the participants list while sharing
zoom-setup-layout-share-participants-exp: Zoom hides its meeting window while it shares the media. M³ then opens Zoom's participants list in its place, so you still see who raises a hand to comment.
zoom-setup-layout-snap-explain: Windows treats them as snapped side by side, as if you had dragged them to the edges of the screen, so dragging the border between them resizes both. To snap them, M³ brings each window forward for a moment.
zoom-setup-layout-split-intro: Drag the divider to share the screen between M³ and Zoom. This is the screen's real shape.
zoom-setup-layout-too-small: This screen is too small for both windows at their smallest: Zoom keeps its minimum size, and M³ gets the rest.
zoom-setup-meeting-host-hint: Start or join the meeting from the Zoom app, signed in as its host.
zoom-setup-meeting-id-invalid: That doesn't look like a Zoom meeting ID. It has 9 to 11 digits, like 123 4567 8901.
zoom-setup-meeting-id-missing: Without a meeting ID, M³ can't open the meeting for you, but everything else still works.
zoom-setup-meeting-intro: Enter the meeting ID of your congregation's Zoom meeting, or paste its invitation link.
zoom-setup-meeting-waiting: Waiting for your Zoom meeting… Open it in Zoom to continue.
zoom-setup-mic-done: M³ knows your microphone button: “{on}” while it's on, “{off}” while it's muted.
zoom-setup-mic-failed: M³ couldn't switch your microphone. Make sure your meeting is open, then try again.
zoom-setup-mic-intro: M³ also needs to learn what your microphone button says, so it can unmute the Kingdom Hall audio when the meeting starts. It will join computer audio if needed, then switch your microphone once and back.
zoom-setup-mic-audio-unknown: M³ can't tell whether computer audio is joined: Zoom's microphone button has no keyboard shortcut, and M³ hasn't learned its names yet. If computer audio is joined in Zoom, say so below; otherwise join it in Zoom, then try again.
zoom-setup-mic-join-failed: M³ couldn't join computer audio. Make sure your meeting is open, then try again.
zoom-setup-mic-question: Is your microphone on (not muted) in Zoom right now?
zoom-setup-music-needed-after-meeting: After a meeting, the before/after-meeting settings are applied when background music is started, but background music is turned off.
zoom-setup-obs-sharing-off: Zoom can't share the media window while @:obsStudio has a media scene set, since @:obsStudio already shows the media in Zoom.
zoom-setup-participants-not-found: Zoom names its buttons in your language, so M³ needs your help to find the one that opens the participants list.
zoom-setup-participants-not-opened: That didn't open the participants list. Pick another one.
zoom-setup-participants-pick: Which of these opens the participants list in your Zoom?
zoom-setup-mute-all-not-found: M³ didn't recognize the button that mutes everyone. If you are the meeting's host, point it out below; M³ will press it and decline Zoom's confirmation, so nobody gets muted.
zoom-setup-mute-all-not-opened: That didn't ask to confirm muting everyone. Pick another one.
zoom-setup-stop-share-not-found: Zoom is still sharing, and M³ didn't recognize the button that stops it. Point it out below.
zoom-setup-stop-share-not-opened: That didn't stop sharing. Pick another one.
zoom-setup-react-not-found: Zoom names its buttons in your language, so M³ needs your help to find the button that raises your hand in Zoom: its React button, or its “Raise hand” button on accounts where reactions are turned off.
zoom-setup-react-not-opened: That didn't raise your hand. Pick another one.
zoom-setup-react-pick: Which of these raises your hand in Zoom?
zoom-setup-relearn-intro: Zoom's buttons no longer read the way M³ learned them, usually because Zoom's language was changed or Zoom was updated. Go through the steps again so M³ learns their new names.
zoom-setup-requirements: You'll need the Zoom desktop app, signed in as the host of your congregation's meeting.
zoom-setup-share-done: Zoom's share window opens and offers the media window.
zoom-setup-share-failed: M³ couldn't open Zoom's share window. Make sure your Zoom meeting is still open, then check again.
zoom-setup-share-intro: M³ can share its media window in Zoom whenever media is shown. Let's check that it works. Nothing will be shared.
zoom-setup-share-not-found: Zoom names its buttons in your language, so M³ needs your help to find the one that shares your screen.
zoom-setup-share-not-listed: Zoom's share window opened, but the media window wasn't in it. Try again in a moment.
zoom-setup-share-not-opened: That didn't open Zoom's share window. Pick another one.
zoom-setup-share-not-selected: Zoom offers the media window, but M³ couldn't select it in Zoom's share window. Close any message or window in front of it, then check again.
zoom-setup-share-pick: Which of these starts screen sharing in your Zoom?
zoom-setup-summary-automations: No automatic actions turned on | 1 automatic action turned on | {count} automatic actions turned on
zoom-setup-summary-layout: M³ arranges its window and Zoom's
zoom-setup-summary-no-layout: M³ leaves the windows where they are
zoom-setup-test-failed: Something didn't work. Check the steps marked in red, then run the test again.
zoom-setup-test-intro: M³ will leave and rejoin computer audio, switch your camera off and on, and share and stop sharing the media window. It won't mute anyone.
zoom-setup-video-done: M³ knows your camera button: “{on}” while it's on, “{off}” while it's off.
zoom-setup-video-failed: M³ couldn't switch your camera. Make sure your meeting is open, then try again.
zoom-setup-video-intro: Zoom names its buttons in your language, so M³ needs to learn what your camera button says. It will switch your camera off and back on once.
zoom-setup-video-question: Is your camera on in Zoom right now?
zoom-setup-welcome-intro: M³ can handle the routine Zoom tasks around each meeting, so you can focus on the meeting itself. This assistant sets it up in a few minutes.
zoom-setup-welcome-title: Let M³ take care of Zoom
zoom-sharing-failed-caption: Share the media window from Zoom yourself.
zoom-sharing-no-meeting: No Zoom meeting is open, so the media wasn't shared in Zoom
zoom-sharing-paused: Zoom automations are paused, so the media wasn't shared in Zoom
zoomAutoFocusMediaWindow: Focar automaticamente a janela de multimédia após o início da partilha de ecrã no Zoom
zoomAutoFocusMediaWindow-explain: Isto geralmente não é necessário, mas pode ser útil em alguns sistemas se a janela de multimédia perder o foco regularmente após o início da partilha de ecrã no Zoom.
zoomCancelAutomationShortcut: Shortcut to cancel a Zoom automation
zoomCancelAutomationShortcut-explain: While M³ operates Zoom (which moves the mouse and focus for a moment), this keyboard shortcut stops it at once, even while Zoom has the focus. It is only active while an automation is running.
zoomDisplaySetupHelp: Help set up Zoom for remote participants
zoomDisplaySetupHelp-explain: Before each meeting, M³ asks whether any of the day's parts will be presented by someone on Zoom. If so, it walks you through putting the Zoom window full screen on the TV, behind the media display, so everyone in the hall can see them when it's time for their part, and shows you how to switch between the media display and the Zoom window. With the Zoom Meeting Manager turned on, M³ also moves the Zoom window to the TV and makes it full screen for you.
zoomEnable-explain: This will not automate Zoom fully. Rather, it will attempt to start and stop Zoom screen sharing using the keyboard shortcut configured in Zoom's "Start/stop screen sharing" setting whenever media starts and stops playing in M³.
zoomMeetingManagerAutoLaunchMeeting-expl: An hour and a quarter before a meeting (or when M³ starts, if that's later), M³ will launch the configured Zoom meeting only if no main Zoom meeting window is found.
zoomMeetingManagerAutomateMediaSharing-e: Automatically share the media window on Zoom when media is shared on TVs.
zoomMeetingManagerAutomateMeetingAudioSe: Automate settings that should be applied during meetings

This will get triggered a few moments before a meeting starts, when background music stops (whether or not it's playing). It will join computer audio, unmute the host microphone, turn on host video, mute everyone, and disable unmuting microphones. Those items are then ticked off the before-meeting checklist.
zoomMeetingManagerAutomatePostMeetingAud: Automate settings that should be applied before and after meetings

Before a meeting, this will get triggered an hour and a quarter before it starts (or when M³ starts, if that's later), after M³'s check of Zoom if that's turned on. After a meeting, it will get triggered when background music is started. It will leave computer audio, turn off host video, allow everyone to unmute, and ask everyone to unmute. After a meeting, those items are then ticked off the after-meeting checklist.
zoomMeetingManagerEnable-explain: Enable the beta Zoom Meeting Manager integration.
zoomMeetingManagerHandAlert-explain: During a meeting, M³ watches Zoom's participants list for raised hands. When someone raises their hand, a notification in M³ lets you unmute that participant with one click, and later mute them again and lower their hand. The Zoom button on the action island lists the raised hands too. If the meeting timer is enabled, a large hand with the participant's name also appears on the timer display for the chairman. M³ first needs to learn how Zoom marks raised hands in your language, with the button below.
zoomMeetingManagerHandAlertNotifyOnly: Only tell me about raised hands
zoomMeetingManagerHandAlertNotifyOnly-ex: M³ still notices who raises their hand, in its notification and on the timer display, but offers no buttons that unmute a participant or lower their hand: you do those in Zoom yourself. Turn this on where you would rather keep control of participant audio and hands.
zoomMeetingManagerMeetingId-explain: Meeting ID that will be used when launching Zoom Meeting Manager.
zoomMeetingManagerMuteHostMicDuringMedia: Mute the host microphone while videos and audio play

While M³ shares a video or an audio file in Zoom, it mutes the host microphone, and unmutes it once the media is finished. Zoom already gets the media’s sound through the share. If the hall’s sound desk also sends it back to the computer’s microphone input, Zoom hears it twice, which can make it sound muffled or choppy for Zoom participants.
zoomMeetingManagerPostMeetingAskToUnmute: After letting everyone unmute, M³ also presses Zoom's "Ask all to unmute" button. Participants who agreed beforehand to be unmuted by the host are then unmuted right away. Turn this off to leave everyone muted, free to unmute themselves when they're ready.
zoomMeetingManagerSetupAssistant-explain: Walks you through connecting M³ to Zoom, checks that everything works, and lets you choose what M³ does for you.
zoomMeetingManagerStartupCheck-explain: On meeting days, M³ checks that everything it automates in Zoom works, in the hour and a quarter before the meeting starts (when background music can start on its own), opening your congregation's meeting if it isn't open yet. As that presses some of Zoom's buttons, M³ asks you first. When others are already in the meeting, it only looks for Zoom's controls, without pressing anything or asking. If something doesn't work, M³ tells you and pauses its Zoom automations until it's restarted or a new check passes.
zoomScreenShareShortcut: Atalho para partilha de ecrã do Zoom
zoomScreenShareShortcut-explain: Introduza o atalho de teclado configurado na definição “Iniciar/parar partilha de ecrã” do Zoom. O M³ enviará este atalho quando a reprodução de multimédia começar (para iniciar a partilha de ecrã) e quando terminar (para parar a partilha de ecrã). Para utilizar esta funcionalidade, é necessário ativar a opção “Atalho global” para esse atalho específico nas definições do Zoom.
zoomMeetingManagerWindowLayout-explain: Where M³ puts Zoom's meeting window and its own on this computer's screens when the meeting starts, and keeps Zoom while the meeting goes on.
